title: Compact session header · round 2 · top bar
intro: Claude Design, 27 Nov 2026. The window top bar after the 32 pt custom bar was built: what height is right on every Mac, and what the bar does in full screen when the traffic lights come and go. Rules: rules.md § Round 2.

Pick Q1: N · back to the native NSToolbar .unifiedCompact (AppKit sets the height, 40 pt here, and the inset after the lights). M · keep the custom bar, but measure height and inset at run time. Never a fixed 28 or 69.

Pick Q2: ride along · no fixed gap; the left items slide right while the lights show and back when they hide, on the menu bar's own clock. No notch: the bar rides down under the menu bar. Notch: the bar stays under the black band.
